decision.reason: [ev-d217f6ac2a1d] is only a table-of-contents entry in the upgrade guide ("5. Start using v2 features") that links to a section. It names no specific feature, API, field or behaviour, and it says nothing about what changed, who is exposed or what happens if the operator does nothing. The body of section 5 of the upgrade guide (the content after the anchor) is needed before subject, change, applicability or consequence can be written.
